title: Monotonicity of guarded reachability
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with oracle, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ and $G'$ be predicates on configurations. If a run reaches configuration $b$ from configuration $a$ with $G$ holding at every configuration before reaching $b$, and every configuration satisfying $G$ also satisfies $G'$, then it reaches $b$ from $a$ with $G'$ holding at every configuration before reaching $b$.
